# Website animation scripts

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 were downloaded from the official `gsap` npm package and checked against its published SHA-512 integrity value. They are served locally, without a runtime CDN dependency.

These third-party files retain their embedded notices and the [GSAP standard license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/). They are not covered by DnDGPT's MIT license. The homepage's Cabinet Grotesk font is served by [Fontshare](https://www.fontshare.com/fonts/cabinet-grotesk) under its own license and is not redistributed in this repository. Fantasy artwork credits are in [ARTWORK.md](../ARTWORK.md).
